subject: Immediate maintenance: on-call triggered safety intervention for inference runtime
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Gomez <lara.gomez@acmeai.com>, infraops@acmeai.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Immediate maintenance: on-call triggered safety intervention for inference runtime

Hi Lara / Acme infra team,

I wanted to alert you right away: our on-call detected an emerging memory-corruption signal on instances serving the rdlm-13B model. To prevent wider impact we are initiating a short maintenance window to apply a targeted safeguard patch (no model changes). The intervention will: 

- Quiesce new requests to affected hosts for 10 minutes
- Apply a binary-level guard that prevents a rare allocator path from hitting an unsafe state
- Run a set of smoke tests and reintroduce hosts gradually under canary

Estimated customer impact: some requests may see 1–3s extra latency while we reroute, and a ~1% chance of a 503 for in-flight requests that are retried automatically by the client. We do not anticipate data loss.

Timing: starting now (09:12 PDT). We expect the canary verification to complete within 20–30 minutes. I will post an update to the incident status page and follow up with a short postmortem link after verification.

If you have an immediate concern or require us to pause for your side, reply to this thread and I will prioritize.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: runtime-safeguard-patch-brief.pdf (1 page)
From: Lara Gomez <lara.gomez@acmeai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 09:18:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Immediate maintenance: on-call triggered safety intervention for inference runtime

Thanks for the heads up, Soojin.

Acme is on standby — our client-facing services are sensitive to even short 503s, so please call out any endpoints/paths you expect to touch. We will throttle our non-critical traffic client-side for the next 30 minutes.

Can you confirm whether embeddings endpoints are affected or only text-generation chat endpoints?

— Lara
Lara Gomez
Director, Infrastructure — Acme AI
lara.gomez@acmeai.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Lara Gomez <lara.gomez@acmeai.com>, infraops@acmeai.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 12:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Immediate maintenance: on-call triggered safety intervention for inference runtime

Lara — short answer, embeddings traffic for Acme is on a separate pool (emb-agg-usw). We will restrict the routing change to the chat/generation pool (rdlm-13b-usw).

Status: canary was applied to 3 nodes at 09:22; smoke tests passed at 09:35. We gradually ramped traffic and observed normal latencies after 09:48. Rolling patch to remainder of the pool completed by 10:10. No client-visible errors after roll.

Next steps:
- We will publish a brief postmortem and the patch notes to the incident folder: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/incident-20280611-postmortem
- Internal RCA ticket created: RCI-20280611-77
- Recommended customer action: no action required. If you observed any anomalies, collect request IDs and send to infraops@acmeai.com + me.

Thanks for the quick coordination.

Ben Carter
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
Attachment: smoke-test-checklist.txt
